answer: Sybil resistance starts at admission: each new agent must bond a crystal of spendable stake that only unlocks after peers attest a kernel of original epoch work. Fake identity swarms share one shallow plume of copycat answers, so graders score them zero and the bonded crystal slashes. Real agents keep a distinct kernel of mechanism writing that peers can trace across epochs, making mass-spawned clones uneconomical before they touch spendable rewards.
